decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Recommend Refusal
Reasons
1/ The  erection of an advertisement banner in this position would by reason of its size, position and appearance  in relation to the attractive bridge and riverside area, be unduly obtrusive,  and is contrary to the Policies ENV 1.1 (All New Development) and   ENV 1.7  (Advertisements) of the Unitary Development Plan and ENVB 1.1 (New Developments) and ENVB 1.4 (Advertisements)  of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan .     
2/ The  erection of an advertisement banner in this position would by reason of its size, position and appearance  not preserve or enhance the character of the  Conservation Area and is contrary to the Policy ENV 1.2 (Conservation Areas)  of the Unitary Development Plan and  ENVB 2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.
description: Installation of temporary advertising banner to site
